mainEntity.name: What is the best marketing strategy for a small cleaning company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with your Google Business Profile and a review system. A cleaning company with a steady flow of recent Google reviews and an optimized GBP gives itself a better shot at the map pack. Add Local Services Ads once reviews are active and your category qualifies: the Google Verified badge builds the in-home trust that cleaning clients need. In 2025, 83% of consumers said they use Google to read reviews. The map pack is where cleaning clients find you first.

mainEntity.name: Do HVAC companies need Google Ads or Local Services Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both, but for different parts of the business. Local Services Ads work best for emergency and repair calls where the customer decides same-day and the pay-per-lead model fits the economics. Google Search Ads work better for replacement and installation queries, where the customer is researching over several weeks. Running one undifferentiated campaign for both mixes two incompatible bid strategies. Keep emergency and replacement as separate campaigns with separate landing pages.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take a remodeling customer to decide?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies by project size and budget, but expect weeks, not days, from first search to requesting bids. During that window, they are reading reviews, looking at completed project photos, and comparing contractors on Google. Your marketing needs to place you on their shortlist during the research phase, not only at the moment they are ready to call. Local SEO and a strong Google Business Profile presence do the work during research. Google Search Ads catch the bid-ready searches at the end of the cycle.

mainEntity.name: Are Local Services Ads available for all service trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Google screens each business, and the checks vary by category and region. Check Google's current eligibility for your specific trade and city before you plan a campaign around Local Services Ads.

mainEntity.name: What marketing channel works best for a med spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: A combination of Instagram for discovery and Google Business Profile with Search Ads for conversion. Aesthetic clients discover services visually, often through social media before they ever search on Google. In 2026, Yext found that 47% of US adults used AI tools for local search in the previous month, which means some prospects will first meet your business through an AI answer. High-intent Google Search Ads for terms like 'med spa near me' or 'Botox [city]' close the deal once the prospect is ready to book.
